description: Takes one or more purchase requisitions (description, goods or service, pricing fixed or time and material, amount, budget basis, cost centre, date needed, supplier, new supplier yes/no, number of offers, direct award reason, personal data yes/no, data processing agreement yes/no, quantity) and returns per requisition what will make it come back: missing description, amount or cost centre (red), a service with personal data and no data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR (red), one supplier above the three-offer threshold without a reason (red) or with a weak reason such as good experience (yellow), time and material without a cap, a budget without a basis, mixed goods and service, and a lead time that is too short, with the latest date to start sourcing (longer for a new supplier). Thresholds are adjustable assumptions; the company's buying policy applies. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored, not legal advice. To plan the steps from request to offer use plan_request_to_offer. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Optional: reference date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

lead_days_new_supplier.description: Optional: usual lead time in days with a new supplier. Default 25.

lead_days_standard.description: Optional: usual lead time in days with a known supplier. Default 10.

rows.description: One row per requisition: id, description, type (goods, service, mixed), pricing (fixed, time and material), amount, budget_basis, cost_center, needed_by, supplier, new_supplier, offers, direct_award_reason, personal_data, dpa, quantity. German column names work too (beschreibung, art, preisart, betrag, herleitung, kostenstelle, bedarfstermin, lieferant, neuer lieferant, angebote, begruendung, personenbezogene daten, avv, menge).

three_offers_from_eur.description: Optional: amount from which three offers are the rule. Default 5000.

name: check_requisition
title: Requisition check: required details, pricing, budget basis, data protection, direct award reason and lead time before a requisition is submitted
